title: Qwen3.5-9B AtomicChat GGUF Q4_K_M on llama.cpp, DGX Spark
slug_note: AtomicChat's Q4_K_M 9B in llama.cpp: 38.2 tok/s at 8K context - 2% above the same weights through Ollama.

variation.revision_note: HF snapshot resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-11-16 test

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-11-16): 5.5 GB resident on the GPU (nvidia-smi, cell's own llama-server, weights + KV at -c 8192); file 5.63 GB.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start). On Ubuntu / DGX OS install libssl-dev first, or -hf cannot download.

measurements.method: openai_bench (SR-344 short_bench.py): streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (631-token prompt, 256 output tokens)

openai_bench (SR-344 short_bench.py): streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write an LRU cache module with tests (37-token prompt, 512 output tokens)

openai_bench (SR-344 short_bench.py): streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; write a 400-word essay (31-token prompt, 512 output tokens)

openai_bench (SR-344 short_bench.py): streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; time to first streamed token on the ~630-token summarise prompt
nvidia-smi per-process GPU allocation for the cell's own server during the bench (weights + KV at -c 8192); llama.cpp build 12035 (commit 4e910a86e) with -c 8192

caveats: Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-11-16): `llama-server -hf AtomicChat/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF:Q4_K_M --jinja -c 8192` - llama.cpp build 12035 (commit 4e910a86e); server ready 6.0 s after start; the functional check passed.

GPU utilisation 0 before the bench; the only other GPU process was an idle 26 GB stage server (no foreign load). See the AtomicChat card for the quant method and quality table; speed here is our own measurement.
Served at -c 8192 for comparability with the queue; the weights support much longer context - memory grows with it.
